supersedingDecision.decision: Cratis/AI.Distribution is superseded as an architectural fixture. The target end state is one repository: Cratis/AI is the only authoring surface, generated distribution is separated inside it by ref and subtree, and Cratis/AI.Distribution becomes a CI-published mirror and is then archived. The boundary that keeps generated bytes unhand-edited becomes ref/subtree rather than repository.
supersedingDecision.note: Phase 2 is now implemented in code for the public marketplace lane, which stages, verifies, pushes, tags, and releases inside Cratis/AI. The repository, control-plane, and review-candidate fields below still describe the lanes deliberately left on the two-repository shape: the S10-gated governed release lane, the disabled approved-profile activation job, and the credential-gated fixture and candidate review lane. None of those can execute today, and nothing in this record changes a gate, a validator, or a policy mode.
executionRequires: a protected orphan distribution branch in Cratis/AI, writable only by the release workflow
re-pointing the distribution and release workflows at that branch and the dist/vX.Y.Z tags
moving the verification control plane into Cratis/AI with all seven required checks intact
re-running the host install evidence at the new ref
archiving Cratis/AI.Distribution after its tags stop being cited by live documentation

landedInCode: .github/workflows/distribution-public-marketplace.yml reads Cratis/AI@distribution as the current generated state, verifies the staged tree, pushes it to refs/heads/distribution, creates the immutable dist/vX.Y.Z tag, re-verifies the published branch, and publishes the GitHub release that now carries the asset set
.github/workflows/verify-distribution-branch.yml runs all seven required checks against the protected branch from Cratis/AI itself

tooling/generate-marketplace-pointer-manifests.mjs emits the four thin pointer marketplace manifests whose plugin source resolves the immutable tag, so the Cratis/AI default branch never exposes the authored root skills tree
tooling/generate-public-marketplace-distribution.mjs records distributionRepository Cratis/AI and distributionRef dist/vX.Y.Z, and the control-plane validator enforces both
tooling/stage-public-marketplace-repository.mjs stages a complete tree when the distribution branch does not exist yet, so the first bootstrap run can initialize it
phase2Execution.lanesDeliberatelyNotRePointedReason: Those lanes do not merely name a repository: they clone it, replace its root with rsync --delete, open a pull request against its default branch, and merge and release there. A name-only re-point would aim that shape at the Cratis/AI authoring surface, which is exactly what the ref-and-subtree boundary exists to prevent. They stay coherent and inert on the two-repository shape until they are migrated with the gate that blocks them.

appliedOutOfBandByRepositoryAdmin.note: Branch and tag protection are configured by the repository admin through the GitHub API, exactly like the distribution-canary and npm-stage protected environments recorded in distribution/remote-repository-state.json. No workflow creates or protects them, and no pull request can. Record the exact protection settings here once they are applied.
required: create the orphan distribution branch in Cratis/AI
protect distribution with force-push disabled, deletion disabled, administrators included, and no human push path
protect the dist/* tag namespace so a release tag is immutable once created
run the re-pointed Stage Public Marketplace Distribution workflow once to produce the first Cratis/AI-hosted release and re-run the host install evidence at the new ref
